usage_notes: Keep private. Copy entry_template into entries for each candidate; the template itself is not a submission.
Use null for unknown amounts/dates, never guessed zeros or URLs. Monetary values need currency and cadence.
Modes: research_only, prepare, submit, resume. Listing states are defined in SKILL.md.
Paid authorizations record destination, plan, currency, ceiling, cadence, and owner authorization reference; no credentials/card data.
Commitments reserve budget while charges are pending. Do not double-count a confirmed charge and its own commitment. Keep currencies separate unless an owner-approved conversion basis exists.
Recurring plans need cadence and an authorized commitment period; monthly price alone is not total campaign cost.
History items record timestamp, observed state, action/result, and evidence. Preserve receipt and public listing URLs separately.
Do not retain token-bearing URLs, credentials, cookies, payment details, or private email contents. Redact sensitive evidence.
Public exports omit contact details, private receipts, management URLs, and sensitive evidence unless explicitly requested for that audience.
